learning.learning_goal: Connect number names, numerals, and groups from 11 through 12.
learning.big_idea: A number tells how many dots there are.
novice_success_criteria: Recognize a number name and count a new arrangement.

screens.title: Meet 11–12.
screens.audio: Listen to the numbers. Count the dots. Then try it yourself.

screens.label: Number 11
screens.title: 11 — eleven
screens.audio: This is eleven. Tap the dots to hear them in order.

visual.ariaLabel: 11 blue dots. First ten, then 1 more.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count every dot once. Choose the number.

visual.ariaLabel: 11 blue dots. First ten, then 1 more.

choices.feedback: Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.
Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.

hints: Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.
Count on from ten to eleven.

screens.label: Number 12
screens.title: 12 — twelve
screens.audio: This is twelve. Tap the dots to hear them in order.

visual.ariaLabel: 12 blue dots. First ten, then 2 more.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count every dot once. Choose the number.

visual.ariaLabel: 12 blue dots. First ten, then 2 more.

choices.feedback: Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.
Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.

hints: Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.
Count on from ten to twelve.

screens.label: Make a group
screens.title: Make 12 dots.
screens.audio: Tap Add a dot until you have twelve dots. Check your dots.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count again. Add or remove a dot.
screens.tooFewFeedback: You need 12 dots. Add a dot, then count again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: You need 12 dots. Remove a dot, then count again.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Tap the number that shows how many dots there are.

choices.feedback: Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.
Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.

hints: Start at the left. Touch each dot as you count.
Count each dot once. Then tap the number you reached.
